query: audit this feature against clean code. analysis_options.yaml enables camel_case_types, and its analyzer exclude list covers **/*.freezed.dart
expected_behavior: The generated file itself is skipped and named on the Not checked line, never audited
A variant name in the hand-written source that produces a badly cased generated class is still reported, against the source file, because the excluded file means no analyzer ever reports it

must_not: Drop the finding on the grounds that camel_case_types is enabled, without checking whether the analyzer can see the file at all
